CFML Language Reference: Functions

MonthAsString

Converts a month number from 1 to 12 into its English name.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

MonthAsString(month_number)

Parameters

month_number
A number from 1 to 12.

Returns

The full English name of the month, for example "October".

Usage

A number outside 1 to 12 throws a parameter validation error. For an abbreviated name, use Left or DateFormat with the mmm mask.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="M" FROM="1" TO="12">
  <TD>#M#<BR><B>#MonthAsString(M)#</B><BR>#Left(MonthAsString(M), 3)#</TD>
  <CFIF M MOD 4 EQ 0></TR><TR></CFIF>
</CFLOOP>
</TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Month, DayOfWeekAsString, DateFormat
